title: How Far Does Lossless Re-tokenization Move an RLVR Update?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models assign different probabilities to token sequences that decode to the same string. In reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), a trainer that re-encodes sampled text may train on a different token sequence with the same reward. We ask how far this moves a training update, and whether the movement has a consistent direction. From one checkpoint, we compare updates on the same rollouts, canonical and with selected tokens split into two pieces, against an update on a different batch. On Qwen2.5-0.5B with three-digit addition, splitting about one token in 25 moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the batch. The ratio rises with the fraction split in four models and depends on which tokens are split; within a checkpoint, the displacements share a direction across batches. translated_title: 无损重新分词会将RLVR训练更新移动多远？
translated_abstract: 语言模型会对解码为同一字符串的不同token序列赋予不同的概率。在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，若训练器对采样文本重新编码，可能会在具有相同奖励的另一条token序列上进行训练。我们探究这种重新分词会将训练更新移动多远，以及这种移动是否具有一致的方向。从一个检查点出发，我们在相同的rollout上比较不同更新——包括规范编码版本和将选定token拆分为两段后的版本——并与在不同批次上的更新进行对比。在Qwen2.5-0.5B上进行三位数加法任务时，每25个token中拆分约1个，产生的更新位移可达更换整个批次效果距离的0.556倍。该比值在四个模型中均随拆分比例上升而增大，且取决于拆分了哪些token；在同一检查点内，不同批次间的位移共享同一方向。在一个每个分词方式对应一张参数表、且只采样单个字符串的表格模型中，我们证明了……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 在RLVR训练中，对采样文本进行无损重新分词（如拆分少量token）会使策略梯度更新产生显著位移——其位移距离可达更换整个批次的0.556倍以上，且在同一检查点内这些位移方向保持一致。
en_tdlr: Lossless re-tokenization in RLVR can shift the training update substantially—splitting roughly 1 in 25 tokens moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the entire batch—and within a checkpoint, these displacements share a consistent direction.
